texts.70b0b407c515: The data supplied will be used only for the approved medical research project - MR1018 - MELAMONA FOLLOW-UP & CASE-CONTROL FAMILY STUDY
texts.7a71444813ea: This is both a case control study (which looks at the causes of melanoma) and a cohort study (which addresses the reason for relapse).  the case control will recruit melanoma patients ,their siblings (any affected and unaffected), and a population control.  the study will look at similarities and differences in environment, stress, diet. illnesses, life-events and sun exposure in patients and unaffected controls who share the gene pool and who do not. Aim The primary aim is to establish the determinants of relapse  from melanoma.  So far the study has over 900 melanoma patients and over 200 unaffected population controls have been recruited.  First aim is the case-control  comparison which purpose data collected from cases will be compared with data collected from 500 population ascertained controls- this group will not be flagged.Second aim to understand the genetic and environmental determinants of relapse.  Recruits will be followed-up for five years.
